parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit passes. It is one file, src/app/logo/logo.service.ts, and it handles one concern: fetching a favicon or logo for an asset. LogoService has two public entry points. getLogoByDataSourceAndSymbol looks up the asset's URL through the injected SymbolProfileService, and getLogoByUrl takes a URL directly. Both hand off to the same private getBuffer helper. That means the fetch logic lives in one place: the gstatic favicon endpoint, the User-Agent header, the timeout read from ConfigurationService, and the conversion to a buffer. Profile lookups go through SymbolProfileService rather than reaching around it. The NOT_FOUND HttpException is built twice, but both copies sit in the same method and only report errors. They don't restate a domain rule or invariant, so this isn't duplication the rubric would flag. Nothing in the file splits into unrelated concerns or bypasses the module's own abstractions.
